attributes.name: Erutaki Coat
attributes.powers:
If proficient with light armors, reveal this card to add 1 to your Constitution or Survival non-combat check. 

Recharge this card to reduce Cold or Combat damage dealt to you by 1. 

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0. If proficient with light armors, bury it instead.
